legal.privacyIntro: We collect only the information you choose to send when you ask a question or submit a booking request.
legal.privacyData: This may include your name, contact details, country, hotel, room number when provided, selected trip, preferred date, group size and your message.
legal.privacyUse: We use this information to answer enquiries, arrange requested trip details, communicate about bookings and operate the website securely.
legal.privacySharing: We do not sell enquiry data. Information is shared only when reasonably necessary to handle the requested service or when required by law.
legal.privacyRetention: Records are kept only for as long as reasonably needed for enquiries, bookings, operational records and applicable legal obligations.
legal.privacyRights: You may contact us to ask about, correct or request deletion of personal information we hold, subject to applicable legal requirements.
legal.termsIntro: This website provides trip information and a way to send enquiries and booking requests from Hurghada.
legal.termsBooking: Submitting a form does not by itself create a confirmed booking. A booking is confirmed only after the final trip details, availability and arrangements are confirmed directly with you.
legal.termsPrices: Prices, inclusions, schedules and optional activities may change. The final price and confirmed inclusions are provided before you accept the booking.
legal.termsChanges: Trip order, pickup times or parts of an itinerary may change for operational, weather, safety or supplier reasons. Material changes should be communicated when known.
legal.termsGuest: Guests are responsible for providing accurate booking information, following safety instructions and carrying any documents required for their selected trip.
legal.termsContact: If anything is unclear, contact us before confirming your booking so the final program can be agreed in writing.
